1263-2511-4871-4976.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1308-1563-3899-5434.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

27-3259-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-3259-7297.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

851-1563-2457-4742.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2281-5987-6798.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Angel of Indemnity
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Saffi triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1409-4826-5647.description:
Activate Roxanne by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Roxanne enters, its first ability and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Roxanne.
Resolve the Roxanne trigger, creating an untapped Meteorite token due to Archelos.
When the Meteorite enters, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Activate the Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Roxanne's second ability triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat.

147-780-5256.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities from step 5.

539-2244-4803-6968.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-2244-4803-6968.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

856-1379-5231-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3417-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
3417-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
3417-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to  Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger.
Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger triggers, dealing 100 damage to any target.

725-5296-6702.description:
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Kilo.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Workhorse.
Resolve the Aura of Dominion ability, untapping Kilo.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

413-856-4231-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar
When Cauldron Familar dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

1479-3534-5700-5701-6664.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3534-5700-5701-6664.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Field of the Dead trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2557-5658-6245-6441.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
2557-5658-6245-6441.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
2557-5658-6245-6441.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

222-527-1251-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1251-5147.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2558-4659-5687-5692.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Weapons Trainer, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Repeat.

333-5256-5617.notablePrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-5256-5617.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Shepherd of the Cosmos' power.
Repeat.

575-1207-5412.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-1207-5412.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability.
Repeat.

2681-4348-5881-5885.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, plus an additional {2}{G} if you don't control a commander
2681-4348-5881-5885.notablePrerequisites: Anzrag and Ley Druid do not have summoning sickness.
2681-4348-5881-5885.description:
Activate Anzrag by paying {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, causing opponents to block Anzrag if able this turn.
Cast Obscuring Haze by paying {0} if you control a commander, or {2}{G} otherwise, preventing all combat damage that would be dealt by opposing creatures this turn.
Declare Anzrag as an attacker, attacking any opponent.
If the opponent does not control a creature, activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, it triggers, causing the defending opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
The opponent is forced to block Anzrag, triggering Anzrag, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Any combat damage that would be dealt to Anzrag is prevented by Obscuring Haze.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1991-2011-4214.notablePrerequisites: Tana has power five or greater, does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1991-2011-4214.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tana.
Tana triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability five times by sacrificing five Saprolings, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If Tana has power six or greater and/or a Warrior you control can attack, this combo nets infinite creature tokens.

524-1379-2508.description:
Aether Storm prevents creature spells from being cast.
Collector Ouphe prevents Aether Storm's ability from being activated to destroy it.

141-1638-2060-2445.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Naru Meha and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Naru Meha from the battlefield to your hand and putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Branching Evolution.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1725-3031.description: Omen Machine prevents players from putting more cards in their hand and Drannith Magistrate prevents players from casting the cards otherwise.
